youtube.title: Why Glasses Fog Up When You Walk Indoors 👓 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Cold lenses brought into a warm room cool the air next to them below its dew point. The invisible water vapor in that air condenses into thousands of tiny droplets on the glass. Those droplets scatter light, so the lens looks white and you can barely see.
